scope: Independent read-only review of the current corrected local Q24-19/Q24-20 implementation only. Do not infer whole-product, production, release or promotion readiness.
acceptance_criteria: Every durable admin operation uses its operation-specific atomic method when atomic support is declared. Partial atomic capability fails closed before request audit or mutation.

Non-atomic fallback is restricted to an explicitly non-durable, non-production-safe provider in dev/test identity mode and local/dev/test application environment. Staging, production, unknown and other modes fail closed before mutation.

Admin deactivation resolves the target membership by the actor exact tenant_id and workspace_id, changes only that membership, and revokes sessions only in that same workspace. Other workspaces in the tenant and other tenants retain membership and session state. Last-active-administrator protection uses the same workspace boundary.

Global email/password and shared role_version changes remain protected across tenants. Rejected cross-tenant profile, credential or authorization mutations leave account, memberships, sessions and outbox unchanged.

PostgresIdentityProvider.create_user fails closed before opening a connection without an authorized actor; with an actor it creates the membership in the actor workspace and delegates to the atomic admin_create_user transaction with a completion outbox event.

Password recovery consumes a valid single-use token, resolves the exact user/tenant/workspace membership, rejects inactive membership, updates only global password credentials, and revokes sessions within one transaction. It never upserts or rewrites rick_memberships. A recovery that reads active before concurrent workspace deactivation cannot restore the stale active membership.

The real admin HTTP route is exercised through a callable atomic PostgresIdentityProvider and its returned audit event ID is present in real PostgreSQL outbox and can be projected. Identify the synthetic authentication dependency override and its limits.

Outbox projection remains bounded and idempotent, with retry/dead-letter/manual retry, consumer concurrency, worker runtime composition and restart recovery supported by implementation and test evidence. Identify material residual gaps.

When global user status is already disabled but the exact actor-workspace membership remains active, deactivation disables that membership, revokes only matching workspace sessions, preserves the global disabled status, commits the audit/outbox event, and returns the resulting operation only after transactional success. Explicit unit and live PostgreSQL regressions must cover this inconsistent state.
review_instruction: Use a fresh isolated context. Verify every SHA-256 listed in files before review. Inspect only this packet and its hash-listed implementation/test/evidence files; do not read prior review reports, other status documents, or conversation. Make no repository changes. Return ACCEPT or REJECT for this scoped local implementation, with severity, exact file/line, concrete failure path, evidence/test gap and residual limitations. Specifically test the global-disabled/active-membership state against the source and real PostgreSQL regression. Do not claim whole-product, production, release or promotion acceptance.
